kind: Public source evidence for model_cooldowns Unix seconds; no runtime values
unit: Each numeric model_cooldowns deadline is seconds since Unix epoch, not milliseconds. Storage writes the supplied cooldown_until unchanged, compares it with time.time(), and renders it with datetime.fromtimestamp().
browser_boundary: Convert validated finite nonnegative numeric seconds to milliseconds by multiplying by 1000, without magnitude guessing. Validate converted finite milliseconds and Date.getTime() before formatting; out-of-Date-range values remain unknown. Accept valid fractional seconds and zero; never coerce strings/booleans or expose nested objects.
scope: Repair existing CredentialTable display and regression tests only. No clock-based expiration policy, backend mutation, new API or new feature.
